title: Faithfulness Evaluation Methods in Imaging XAI
source: Data transcribed from Tables 1-11 of Lamprou, Kallipolitis, Ntanos & Askounis, "A Taxonomy of Faithfulness Evaluation Methods in Imaging XAI: A Systematic Review" (2026). 107 review studies, 68 methods, 4 categories. references[] lists each method's defining work with a URL (arXiv id from the paper where available, otherwise a Crossref-verified DOI, otherwise a Google Scholar title-search link); full per-method review-study lists remain in the paper's tables.

methods.name: Pixel-flip
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Progressively perturbs image pixels in decreasing attribution order. Computation: Perturbation curve.

methods.name: Concept Flipping / Concept Insertion
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Concept-level analogue of pixel-flip: concepts are progressively removed or inserted according to their importance. Computation: Perturbation curve.

methods.name: Deletion / Insertion
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Important pixels are progressively removed (Deletion) or added (Insertion); faithfulness read from the area under the prediction curve. Computation: AUC.

methods.name: Ascending-order Deletion (Wu et al. 2024a)
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Deletion variant where pixels are removed in ascending order of importance. Computation: AUC.

methods.name: RD / RI
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Robust Deletion/Insertion variants that compute expected metric scores over perturbed image neighborhoods. Computation: Expected value & AUC.

methods.name: EvalAttAI
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Continuous perturbation scheme where the image is iteratively modified using the attribution map itself. Computation: AUC.

methods.name: Deletion for object detection (Petsiuk et al. 2021)
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: The Deletion metric extended to the object-detection task. Computation: AUC.

methods.name: Superpixel Deletion/Insertion (Yoshikawa et al. 2024)
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Deletion/Insertion extended to superpixels. Computation: AUC.

methods.name: Effect Score
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Deletion/Insertion-based score that penalizes large superpixel explanations. Computation: Weighted mix of Deletion & Insertion.

methods.name: Concept-level Deletion/Insertion (Hasić 2025)
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Deletion/Insertion extended to concept-level explanations. Computation: AUC.

methods.name: SDC / SSC
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Identifies the minimal set of concepts that destroys (SDC) or sustains (SSC) a prediction. Computation: Minimum number of concepts satisfying a condition.
tags: Minimum number of concepts satisfying a condition

methods.name: AOPC
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Measures cumulative prediction change along MoRF/LeRF perturbation curves. Computation: AOPC.

methods.name: ABPC
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Measures the area between the MoRF and LeRF perturbation curves. Computation: AOPC.

methods.name: Comprehensiveness / Sufficiency
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Measures cumulative prediction change when removing or retaining the top-ranked regions. Computation: AOPC.

methods.name: ROAR
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: AOPC variant that retrains the model on explanation-guided modified images to address the OOD issue. Computation: AOPC.

methods.name: ROAD
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: AOPC variant employing Noisy Linear Imputation (NLI) perturbations to mitigate class information leakage. Computation: AOPC.

methods.name: IROF
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: AOPC variant employing a segmentation algorithm to partition images into regions. Computation: AOPC.

methods.name: SaCo
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Pairwise region comparison that evaluates whether higher-saliency regions cause larger confidence drops. Computation: Normalized aggregation of salience score differences.
tags: Normalized aggregation of salience score differences

methods.name: AD / IC
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Compares predictions on the original image and the explanation mask: AD = confidence drop (floored at zero), IC = whether the explanation map increases prediction confidence. Computation: Confidence score comparison.

methods.name: ADₚ / ICₚ
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: AD/IC variants scaled by the percentage of clean pixels to account for explanation sparsity. Computation: Confidence score comparison.

methods.name: ADD
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: AD variant that measures the confidence drop after deleting the most influential region. Computation: Confidence score comparison.

methods.name: Pixel removal from original (Sujana & Augustine 2025)
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Removes the most-important pixels from the original image at once. Computation: Confidence score comparison.

methods.name: Superpixel removal from original (Rodrigues et al. 2024)
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Removes the most-important superpixels from the original image at once. Computation: Confidence score comparison.

methods.name: Concept removal from original (Kumar et al. 2021)
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Removes the most-important concepts from the original image at once. Computation: Confidence score comparison.

methods.name: Irrelevant-superpixel removal (Qian et al. 2025b)
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Removes superpixels deemed irrelevant by the explanation; the remaining image is expected to maintain or increase classifier confidence (aligns with the IC criterion). Computation: Confidence score comparison.

methods.name: F-Fidelity
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Performs model retraining on explanation-agnostic masked images and explanation-guided pixel removal at evaluation to mitigate the OOD issue. Computation: Predicted label comparison.

methods.name: FE (Faithfulness Estimate)
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Correlation between attribution scores and the prediction drop after removing pixels. Computation: PCC.

methods.name: FE (SRCC variant)
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: FE variant using Spearman rank correlation instead of Pearson correlation. Computation: SRCC.

methods.name: DCᴄᴏᵣᵣ / ICᴄᴏᵣᵣ
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Correlation-based variants of the Deletion and Insertion measures. Computation: PCC.

methods.name: FC (Faithfulness Correlation)
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Correlation between the sum of attribution scores over perturbed feature subsets and the corresponding changes in model output. Computation: PCC.

methods.name: Infidelity
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Mean distance between the sum of attribution scores over perturbed feature subsets and the corresponding changes in model output. Computation: Expected value.

methods.name: GEF (Generalized Explanation Faithfulness)
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Geometry-aware correlation between model and explanation distortion vectors under model-parameter perturbations. Computation: SRCC.

methods.name: EMBT (Evolving Model Backdoor Test)
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Correlation between model prediction and attribution assigned to a trigger region across a sequence of progressively backdoor-trained models. Computation: PCC.

methods.name: PTT (Partial Trigger Test)
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Correlation between prediction scores and attribution assigned to a trigger region across inputs with increasing trigger coverage. Computation: PCC.

methods.name: EMT (Evolving Model Test)
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Correlation between training loss and changes in the features identified as important across epoch checkpoints. Computation: PCC.

methods.name: Concept-importance correlation (Li et al. 2021)
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Correlation between concept importance scores and the average prediction drop caused by suppressing each concept. Computation: PCC.

methods.name: Fidelity (classification)
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.subcategory: I.C — Agreement between black-box & explainer predictions
methods.description: Percentage of similar predictions between the black-box and explainer models; black-box predicted labels treated as ground truth. Computation: Accuracy score.

methods.name: Fidelity (regression)
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.subcategory: I.C — Agreement between black-box & explainer predictions
methods.description: Relative error between the black-box and explainer model predictions. Computation: Relative error.

methods.name: MAE agreement (Qi et al. 2021)
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.subcategory: I.C — Agreement between black-box & explainer predictions
methods.description: Mean absolute error between the black-box and explainer model predictions (regression). Computation: MAE.

methods.name: Coherence
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.subcategory: I.C — Agreement between black-box & explainer predictions
methods.description: Strength of the linear relationship between the prediction sequences of the black-box and explainer models; applicable to classification and regression. Computation: Spectral density.

methods.name: Linear faithfulness score
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.subcategory: I.D — Concept scores mapping to predictions
methods.description: Logistic-regression classifier trained on concept activation scores to predict the ViT model's outputs. Computation: Accuracy score.

methods.name: CAM on 2D CNN + GAP
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: CAM applied to a 2D CNN with a GAP layer before the classifier, satisfying an exact additivity property. Computation: Analytical formula.

methods.name: Grad-CAM on last conv + GAP
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Grad-CAM applied to the last convolutional layer of a 2D CNN with a GAP layer before the classifier (reduces to CAM). Computation: Analytical formula.

methods.name: HiResCAM on last conv + GAP
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: HiResCAM applied to the last convolutional layer of a 2D CNN with a GAP layer before the classifier. Computation: Analytical formula.

methods.name: HiResCAM on last conv + Flatten
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: HiResCAM applied to the last convolutional layer of a 2D CNN with a Flatten layer before the classifier (only HiResCAM preserves additivity here). Computation: Analytical formula.

methods.name: HiResCAM on AxialNet
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: HiResCAM applied to the last convolutional layer of the AxialNet architecture (3D volumes). Computation: Analytical formula.

methods.name: AttLRP on Transformer
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: AttLRP algorithm applied to a Transformer architecture, preserving LRP's conservation principle. Computation: Analytical formula.

methods.name: Concept-based decomposition (Zhou et al. 2018)
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Concept-based decomposition applied to a 2D CNN with a GAP layer before the classifier. Computation: Analytical formula.

methods.name: Prototype-based decomposition (Tan et al. 2024)
methods.category: I — Combination of attribution scores & black-box predictions
methods.description: Prototype-based decomposition of the classification head of a part-prototype network, with completeness guarantees. Computation: Analytical formula.

methods.name: Max-Sensitivity
methods.category: II — Sensitivity analysis of attribution scores
methods.description: Maximum change in attribution maps under bounded input perturbations; lower values indicate more faithful (stable) explanations. Computation: Euclidean norm.

methods.name: Opposite-class patch substitution (Amorim et al. 2023)
methods.category: II — Sensitivity analysis of attribution scores
methods.description: Salient regions are replaced with patches from opposite-class images; original and perturbed attribution maps are compared. Computation: Similarity/dissimilarity metrics (jAUC, bAUC, sAUC, NSS, IG, SIM, PCC; MAE, MSE, KL).
tags: Similarity/dissimilarity metrics (jAUC, bAUC, sAUC, NSS, IG, SIM, PCC; MAE, MSE, KL)

methods.name: Thresholded-occlusion stability (Dakhli & Barhoumi 2024)
methods.category: II — Sensitivity analysis of attribution scores
methods.description: Low-importance regions are removed using a thresholded attribution mask; original and occluded predictions and maps are compared. Computation: PCC.

methods.name: Combined impact map (Vukadin et al. 2024a)
methods.category: II — Sensitivity analysis of attribution scores
methods.description: Combines MoRF/LeRF masking and gradient–input maps to derive a combined impact map; alignment between attribution and impact map is evaluated. Computation: Element-wise map product and sum over map dimensions.
tags: Element-wise map product and sum over map dimensions

methods.name: MPRT (Model Parameter Randomization Test)
methods.category: II — Sensitivity analysis of attribution scores
methods.description: Attribution maps are recomputed after randomizing model weights and compared with the originals via similarity metrics. Computation: SRCC, SSIM, PCC of HOGs.

methods.name: sMPRT (Smooth MPRT)
methods.category: II — Sensitivity analysis of attribution scores
methods.description: MPRT refinement using denoised attribution maps averaged over Gaussian-perturbed input instances. Computation: SSIM.

methods.name: eMPRT (Efficient MPRT)
methods.category: II — Sensitivity analysis of attribution scores
methods.description: MPRT refinement using full model randomization and entropy-based comparison of attribution maps. Computation: Relative change in entropy.

methods.name: CSC (Cosine Similarity Convergence)
methods.category: II — Sensitivity analysis of attribution scores
methods.description: Different random initial relevance vectors are backpropagated through the network and the resulting relevance flows are compared. Computation: Cosine similarity.

methods.name: Pointing Game
methods.category: III — Spatial alignment against ground-truth region
methods.description: Checks whether the most important pixels fall inside the human-annotated image region. Computation: Number of hits over total pixels checked.
tags: Number of hits over total pixels checked

methods.name: GridPG
methods.category: III — Spatial alignment against ground-truth region
methods.description: Evaluates whether attribution highlights the correct image cell in a grid of images. Computation: Positive attribution mass in target cell over total positive attribution.
tags: Positive attribution mass in target cell over total positive attribution

methods.name: DiFull
methods.category: III — Spatial alignment against ground-truth region
methods.description: GridPG improvement designed so each grid cell influences only the logit of its own class. Computation: Positive attribution mass in target cell over total positive attribution.
tags: Positive attribution mass in target cell over total positive attribution

methods.name: DiPart
methods.category: III — Spatial alignment against ground-truth region
methods.description: Intermediate between GridPG and DiFull: partial disconnection of grid cells. Computation: Positive attribution mass in target cell over total positive attribution.
tags: Positive attribution mass in target cell over total positive attribution

methods.name: Attribute-Accuracy / Precision / Recall / F1
methods.category: III — Spatial alignment against ground-truth region
methods.description: Classification metrics extended to attribution maps; evaluate whether attribution highlights the target-class cells in a grid of images. Computation: TP, FP, TN, FN classification scores.
tags: TP, FP, TN, FN classification scores

methods.name: LIME
methods.category: IV — Built-in faithfulness objective
methods.description: Explains individual predictions by generating perturbed superpixel samples around the input and fitting a simple interpretable surrogate model. Computation: Local approximation with an interpretable surrogate model.
tags: Local approximation with an interpretable surrogate model

methods.name: UnRAvEL
methods.category: IV — Built-in faithfulness objective
methods.description: Builds on LIME using a Gaussian Process Regression surrogate and a Faithful Uncertainty Reduction (FUR) acquisition function. Computation: Local approximation with an interpretable surrogate model.
tags: Local approximation with an interpretable surrogate model

methods.name: FDbX
methods.category: IV — Built-in faithfulness objective
methods.description: Extends the LIME rationale to Siamese networks: explains similarity predictions by constructing a bipartite graph of superpixels and fitting a Ridge regression surrogate. Computation: Local approximation with an interpretable surrogate model.
tags: Local approximation with an interpretable surrogate model

methods.name: XNN (Qi et al. 2021)
methods.category: IV — Built-in faithfulness objective
methods.description: Explanation Neural Network that learns a low-dimensional explanation space able to mimic the black-box predictions. Computation: Dedicated loss term in the explainer model.
tags: Dedicated loss term in the explainer model

methods.name: PACE
methods.category: IV — Built-in faithfulness objective
methods.description: Explainer model that learns concept relevance scores based on the prediction-probability drop caused by removing each concept. Computation: Dedicated loss term in the explainer model.
tags: Dedicated loss term in the explainer model

methods.name: JMM (Joint Mask Method)
methods.category: IV — Built-in faithfulness objective
methods.description: Mask-based attribution method that jointly optimizes preservation and deletion masks. Computation: Optimization objective of the method.
